title: Personal Financial Literacy: Expenses, Profit, Saving and Banks
seo_title: Grade 4 Personal Financial Literacy Worksheets (TEKS 4.10, Texas)
standard_text: 4.10A distinguish between fixed and variable expenses; 4.10B calculate profit in a given situation; 4.10C compare the advantages and disadvantages of various savings options; 4.10D describe how to allocate a weekly allowance among spending; saving, including for college; and sharing; 4.10E describe the basic purpose of financial institutions, including keeping money safe, borrowing money, and lending
meta_desc: Free Grade 4 personal financial literacy worksheets for Texas TEKS 4.10: fixed and variable expenses, profit, savings options, allowance plans and what banks do. 100 questions with answers.
key_sub: Fixed expenses stay the same; variable expenses change. Split an allowance among spending, saving and sharing.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • A fixed expense costs the same each time (rent). A variable expense can change (groceries, electricity).
  • Profit = income − costs.
  • Savings can be kept at home or in a bank. A savings account is safer and can earn interest.
  • A good allowance plan splits money among spending, saving (including for college) and sharing.
  • Banks and credit unions keep money safe, lend money and borrow money from depositors.

Examples

Example

A bake sale earns $85. Supplies cost $27. What is the profit?

$85 − $27

Answer: $58

Example

Lena gets $12 a week. She saves $4 and gives $2. How much can she spend?

$12 − $4 − $2

Answer: $6

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Calling a bill that changes a fixed expenseFixed means the same amount every time.
Treating all income as profitSubtract the costs first.
Thinking a bank only stores moneyBanks also lend money and pay interest.

items.q: Which is a fixed expense for a family?
items.e: A fixed expense costs the same each time: rent.

items.q: A family pays $900 rent and $60 for phones every month (fixed). Food cost $344, $351 and $335 in three months (variable). What were the total fixed expenses for the three months?
items.e: Fixed expenses are the same each month: 3 × ($900 + $60) = $2,880.
